run_mock_spot_agent: run the MockSpotDemoAgent offline using a pickled voxel map and VLM RPC stub
confirm_plan_mock_agent: confirm or reject a robot action plan through the MockSpotDemoAgent confirm_plan method
mock_wrapper_record_calls: wrap an object with MockWrapper to record all method calls and attribute accesses

mock_wrapper_save_load: save recorded calls to a pickle file and load them back for later replay
